journey.name: save a new pubky profile
journey.description: Precondition: a disposable, unfunded wallet with Paykit enabled, no Pubky identity, PIN off, an English device and a reachable configured signup service. This checks name-only profile creation. Record the build, network and time from tapping Save to Pay Contacts appearing. Do not enable contact payments for this check. After relaunch, Android may show the cached name while the public profile loads; persistence is verified only once the full profile name appears.

actions.action: If the profile introduction appears, tap its Continue button ("ProfileIntro-button")
On the Pubky choice screen, tap "PubkyChoiceCreate"
Wait for "CreateProfileUsername", enter "Profile Save Test" and dismiss the keyboard
Wait for "PayContactsContinue" and record the elapsed saving time
Take a screenshot and verify no profile error is shown
Return Home without pressing "PayContactsContinue", then open Profile using "ProfileButton"
Relaunch the app and open Profile using "ProfileButton"
If "ProfileCachedName" appears while loading, verify it shows "Profile Save Test"; this is not yet the full profile
Wait for the full profile name (id "ProfileViewName", predicate exists). If loading does not finish, report the loading state and elapsed time without claiming the saved name was lost
Verify "ProfileViewName" shows "Profile Save Test" and "ProfileCachedHeader" is gone
